fact: Morocco World News reports that Damanesign is a trust service provider approved by the DGSSI under Law 43-20 and issues qualified certificates for electronic signature and electronic seal; the approval date is not given, so the article's publication date of 2026-10-01 is used.

fact: The DGSSI page presents Loi n° 43-20 on trust services for electronic transactions as the regime fixing the rules for trust services, cryptology means and services, and trust service providers and certificate holders, and setting the powers of the national trust services authority; the page gives no date, so the law's published date of 2020-12-31 is used. The law covers trust services (signatures and certificates) rather than online selling.
system: Loi n° 43-20 relative aux services de confiance pour les transactions électroniques

fact: The DGSSI register of regulated services, applying Articles 8, 17, 46, 52 and 53 of Loi 43-20 on trust services for electronic transactions, treats the law as operating; the page has no date, so its published date of 2026-09-03 is used.
system: Loi n° 43-20 relative aux services de confiance pour les transactions électroniques

fact: The page cites Decree n° 2-22-687 made to apply Law 43-20, which sets transitional periods running from 13 July 2023 (Article 33: six months for non-qualified trust service providers) and lists exempt cryptology means in its annex 6; the same date starts the one-year period under Article 80 of the law for providers approved under Law 53-05.
system: Décret n° 2-22-687 pris pour l'application de la loi n° 43-20

fact: Under Article 53 of Law 43-20 the DGSSI publishes its list of approved trust service providers, which names three: EURAFRIC INFORMATION (AfricTRUST, CertiSign+ and CertiSeal+), Barid Al Maghrib (Classe 3 signature and seal, qualified timestamp) and DamaneSign (qualified signature and seal), all at the qualified level; the page has no date, so its published date of 2026-09-03 is used.
system: DGSSI list of approved trust service providers (PSCo)

fact: The DGSSI lists the conformity certificates it issued under Articles 8 and 17 of Law 43-20 for qualified signature and seal creation devices: six current ones from CC-1/2024 (25 April 2024) to CC-1/2026 (18 March 2026), the latest being an Entrust nShield module.
system: DGSSI qualified signature and seal creation device certificates (QSCD)
